description: Header file defining utilities and classes for handling HEVC (H.265) video codec parameters, including enumerations for NAL unit types, parameter set management, and dimension extraction.
external_methods: status_t addNalUnit(const uint8_t* data, size_t size)
bool write(size_t index, uint8_t* dest, size_t size)
static bool IsHevcIDR(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)

classes.name: HevcParameterSets
classes.description: Class managing HEVC parameter sets, including NAL units, parameter extraction, and dimension calculation.

methods.name: addNalUnit
methods.description: Adds a NAL unit to the parameter set collection.

methods.name: getNumNalUnits
methods.description: Returns the number of NAL units stored.

methods.name: getNumNalUnitsOfType
methods.description: Returns the number of NAL units of a specific type.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of a NAL unit at a given index.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of a NAL unit at a given index.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a NAL unit to a destination buffer.

methods.name: makeHvcc
methods.description: Creates an HVCC (HEVC Video Coding Configuration) box.

methods.name: FindHEVCDimensions
methods.description: Extracts width and height from an SPS buffer.

methods.name: getInfo
methods.description: Returns information flags about the parameter sets.

methods.name: IsHevcIDR
methods.description: Checks if data corresponds to an HEVC IDR frame.
